retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered collage featuring a central photographic portrait framed by vibrant, hand-painted paper cutouts and custom outlined lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of three figures is set against a black background, framed by jagged, colorful paper-like shapes with wavy patterns. The composition is anchored by a large, hand-drawn L-shaped typographic box in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic subject framed by a thin white border
Vibrant, jagged paper cutouts overlapping a solid black background
L-shaped typographic container integrated into the top-left corner
High-contrast color palette between neon accents and dark shadows
coreInvariants: Central rectangular photo frame with a thin white stroke

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures in a medium shot, centered horizontally within a rectangular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The L-shaped typographic box in the top-left corner acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, move down to the central faces, and then circulate around the colorful peripheral cutouts.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background provides high contrast for the vibrant foreground elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background providing depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange, red, and purple in the paper cutouts.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon blue and yellow wavy lines within the cutouts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements contrasts with the naturalistic tones of the central photograph.

letterConstructionRules: Letters contained within a thin-line geometric box
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom lettering style used for all text to maintain a DIY punk/pop aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-drawn, unpolished feel of the original.
Mimics the double-line structure and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black background with jagged, colorful paper cutouts featuring wavy neon patterns. Place a central rectangular photo of three people with a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn double-outline lettering in an L-shape in the top-left corner, ensuring the lines look slightly irregular and sketched.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained in an L-shaped box?
Are the paper cutouts jagged and patterned with wavy lines?
Is the central photo framed by a thin white stroke?
Does the lettering use a double-outline hand-drawn style?

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the paper cutouts
Number of figures in the central photo
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for double-outline consistency in lettering
Ensure paper cutouts have a 'torn' or 'jagged' edge quality
Verify the L-shaped typographic container is present
Confirm the central photo is a distinct rectangular element
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central framed portrait with peripheral neon paper cutouts and a top-left L-shaped hand-drawn outline title.
